Four days in Marrakech, Morocco and I already can't wait to go back! 🇲🇦✨ If you’re planning your first trip to Morocco, Marrakech is the perfect place to dive into the country’s rich culture, incredible food, and beautiful architecture. Between getting lost in the medina, learning to cook traditional Moroccan dishes, and enjoying a little luxury in the Agafay Desert, we packed SO much into four days! One thing I loved most about Marrakech was how every day felt completely different. You can spend one morning exploring centuries of history and the next relaxing poolside with views of the Atlas Mountains. And the hospitality? Some of the best I’ve experienced. 🥹 My biggest recommendation is to leave some room in your Marrakech itinerary to wander, shop, and enjoy the city without rushing from one attraction to the next. 📌 Save this 4-day Marrakech itinerary for your Morocco vacation, and tell me: Would you rather spend a day exploring the souks or relaxing in the Agafay Desert? #MarrakechMorocco #MarrakechItinerary #MoroccoTravel #VisitMarrakech #blacktravelblogger things to do in Marrakech, Marrakech itinerary

🇲🇦😍 Marrakech: uma das cidades mais exóticas e fascinantes do Marrocos! Imagine ruas labirínticas, palácios ornamentados, mercados coloridos, jardins exuberantes e uma arquitetura que parece saída de outro tempo. Marrakech é uma explosão de cores, aromas, sabores e cultura no coração do Marrocos! ✨ 📍 O que conhecer em Marrakech: 🕌 Mesquita Koutoubia – um dos cartões-postais mais famosos da cidade. 🏰 Bahia Palace – um palácio magnífico com jardins e detalhes arquitetônicos impressionantes. 🌸 Jardin Majorelle – um jardim famoso pelo azul intenso e pela vegetação exuberante. 🛍️ Medina de Marrakech – um labirinto de ruas, lojas e mercados tradicionais. 🧡 Jemaa el-Fna – a praça mais famosa da cidade, cheia de movimento e cultura. 🏛️ Ben Youssef Madrasa – uma antiga escola islâmica com arquitetura deslumbrante. 🚪 Bab Agnaou – um dos portões históricos mais impressionantes da cidade. 🌴 El Badi Palace – as ruínas de um antigo palácio de proporções grandiosas. 🧖 Hammam tradicional – uma experiência cultural de banho e relaxamento marroquino. Marrakech é um destino que desperta todos os sentidos e mostra um lado completamente diferente do mundo. 5 things to know before going to Morocco👇🇲🇦 1️⃣ Always carry cash. Morocco is still very cash-based, especially in local shops, markets and smaller restaurants. 💵 2️⃣ Be a responsible tourist. Think twice before paying for animal encounters in Marrakech, particularly the monkeys and snakes in Jemaa el-Fnaa. 🐒 3️⃣ Explore beyond Marrakech. Some of Morocco’s best experiences are outside the city, so make time for places like Chefchaouen, Volubilis and the Atlas Mountains. 🏜️ 4️⃣ Having mobile data when you land makes your arrival so much easier. I use Unpack for my travels. Download the app and use code "ALEX" for 20% off your first eSIM plan. (Link in bio)📱 5️⃣ If you’re visiting on a Friday, make sure you try traditional Moroccan couscous.
